name: Galle Fort
tagline: Historic Dutch fort by the sea
description: The UNESCO-listed 17th-century Dutch fort, a walled peninsula of colonial mansions, boutique cafes, art galleries and ramparts overlooking the Indian Ocean. The most atmospheric and popular base, packed with charm and character.
bestFor: Nomads and travellers wanting colonial charm, cafes and walkable ocean views

name: Unawatuna
tagline: Beach village with surf and cafes
description: A popular beach village just east of Galle with a sheltered bay, palm-lined sand, guesthouses, yoga studios and casual restaurants. A relaxed coastal base blending swimming, surfing nearby and a lively backpacker scene.
bestFor: Beach lovers and social travellers wanting sand, yoga and a laid-back vibe

name: Galle City
tagline: Everyday town outside the fort walls
description: The bustling modern town surrounding the fort, with the main bus and train stations, markets, supermarkets and local shops. Far cheaper than the fort and more authentic, giving practical everyday access to services.
bestFor: Budget-minded long-stayers needing transport, groceries and cheaper rents

name: Dalawella
description: A calmer stretch of coast southeast of Unawatuna, known for its famous rope swing, quieter beaches and small villas set among palms. A more peaceful coastal base for those wanting sea access without the crowds.
bestFor: Travellers wanting a quieter beach base with villas and calm swimming
